we present a new large scale dataset WikiSQL for question to SQL query translation, propose a deep reinforcement learning model Seq2SQL for translating questions to SQL queries, and show that Seq2SQL achieves state of the art results on WikiSQL.
we propose a novel deep neural network model for translating natural language to corresponding SQL queries, and we release a large scale dataset to support research in this area.
we propose Seq2SQL a deep neural network that uses a reinforcement learning approach to generate structured queries from natural language.

the following questions: (i) Can we use a reinforcement learning agent to learn a policy for generating SQL queries from natural language? (ii) Can we use the structure of SQL and relational databases to simplify the generation problem? (iii) How can we evaluate a semantic parser that outputs structured programs such as SQL?

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we propose Seq2SQL for translating natural language into structured SQL queries.

our model outperforms state of the art models in the task of translating natural language questions into structured queries, and that we release a new dataset that is an order or magnitude larger than comparable ones.
the Seq2SQL model outperforms a previous state of the art model on a new and larger dataset, which was created by hand.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are the first to use reinforcement learning for generating SQL queries from natural language questions.
we have developed a novel deep reinforcement learning based model, Seq2SQL, to learn to generate structured SQL queries from natural language questions over the database tables.
we have developed a novel deep learning model that can generate SQL queries from natural language questions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can learn to generate SQL from natural language questions by using rewards obtained by executing the generated SQL queries.
reinforcement learning is well suited for the problem of natural language to SQL translation and that it can be used to train neural networks to learn complex structured generation tasks.
reinforcement learning can be applied successfully to structured output problems, even when the output is not a single string.
